title: Проверка автомобиля перед покупкой
title_en: Buying a used car: pre-purchase inspection
purpose: Public description of the pre-purchase inspection.
differs_from_en: Customers say «проверка перед покупкой»; «автоподбор» is a different service (a person who searches for the car) and is not offered.
Paint-thickness measurement is part of the Russian inspection.
new_facts: Paint-thickness measurement over the body: the ordinary content of such an inspection in Russia.
